summary: Say why, by whom and when a seat that is not running stopped, and let a stop carry its reason

replay.detail: The end reason is derived on read from existing reconcile decisions, runtime observations and stop declarations; no projection is rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table or migration changes. A stop declaration may carry an optional reason in its existing desired body; a stop without one keeps the exact body and revision it always had.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Client-v0 AgentEndReason.kind becomes an open enum and adds parked (actor daemon/runtime, st's reason) and stopped-by-mission (actor the owning run); Swift and Rust already read kind as a string, and the generated TypeScript accepts future strings. A stop by a person or agent now carries its reason. `stop SUBJECT { reason TEXT }` and `st agents stop --reason` are new: a daemon from before this change refuses a stop with a reason child, so publish one only to an upgraded host. `st agents show` adds a WHY line and `st agents ls` an indented line under each seat that is not running.

manual.detail: Nothing to do; parked seats show their reason as soon as the upgraded daemon serves them.

recovery.detail: Rolling back removes the derived reasons from cards; a stop declaration that carries a reason still parses as data and keeps stopping its seat.
